[[Image:Deadwood Village.jpg|thumb|Deadwood Village]]

'''Deadwood Village''' is a [[village]] of the [[Deadwood tribe]] of [[corrupted furbolg]]s in southern [[Felwood]]. The Deadwood furbolgs, like most of their kin, are corrupted and {{reputation|hostile}}. Killing the Deadwoods is a good way to gain [[reputation]] with the furbolgs of [[Timbermaw Hold]].

==Quests to get before arriving==
* {{questlong|Neutral|48|Timbermaw Ally}} - From [[Grazle]] in [[Emerald Sanctuary]].
* {{questlong|Horde|51|A Husband's Last Battle}} - From [[Dreka'Sur]] in [[Bloodvenom Post]].
